Messages.Author: -< Johann Lionheart >-
Messages.Body:
Card text states ..."only usable when a minion is ATTEMPTING to bleed
you for more than 3 pool"...

Does that mean that this card is only usable when a minion has a
default bleed of more than three or if that minion is using an Action
bleed?

Therefore, a minion with only a default bleed of one taps and attempts
to bleed. I choose not to block, he then uses an action modifier to
increase the bleed to 4. Can I then play Archon Investigation, or has
he already successfully bled me, and he is only increasing the pool
loss?

Thanks,
-JZ

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
-< Johann Lionheart >- wrote:
> Card text states ..."only usable when a minion is ATTEMPTING to bleed
> you for more than 3 pool"...
>
> Does that mean that this card is only usable when a minion has a
> default bleed of more than three or if that minion is using an Action
> bleed?

No. It means that the card is only usable when a minion is attempting
to bleed you (i.e., is an acting minion during a bleed action when the
target of the action is you and the action has not yet reached resolution)
and the bleed amount is more than 3.

> Therefore, a minion with only a default bleed of one taps and attempts
> to bleed. I choose not to block, he then uses an action modifier to
> increase the bleed to 4. Can I then play Archon Investigation, or has
> he already successfully bled me, and he is only increasing the pool
> loss?

You can play it.
He hasn't successfully bleed you until resolution.

Messages.Body:
If Arika was bleeding you and she had previously done a spying mission, you
could not burn her because she only attempts to bleed for 3.
